source_snapshot.procedure: Read SDR/sensors, observe temperature changes and thresholds, then `Try to full the SEL` and check a threshold event.
source_snapshot.criteria: Normal temperature behavior, thresholds/type match SPEC, and an SEL record at threshold.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES using only SDR/sensor reads; it neither generates nor reads the required event and labels the test no-risk.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED for undefined InfoErr taxonomy, duplicate code, unsafe stimulus and SEL-full ambiguity.

old_problem: The source duplicates RealErr behavior without defining the distinguishing InfoErr event, and joins a sensor threshold action to an undefined SEL-fill operation. Read-only inventory cannot supply either functional result.
disposition_reason: ED duplicate-identity rules resolve the code collision by retaining row 765 / variant 6005b7c0e0c6aea7 separately from row 1487 / variant 366c387843189ec1. They do not define the platform-specific InfoErr class, a non-overlapping event code/severity, a safe target/stimulus, or whether SEL-full means stop-on-full, circular overwrite, overflow indication or another OEM policy. IPMI defines standard sensor/SEL structures but not this project's InfoErr label. Executing would guess the core event and could destroy evidence.
decision_basis: XLSX row 765, its same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record were directly read.
The unrelated duplicate-code row 1487 was directly reopened and its distinct DIMM Information identity/variant preserved; it supplies no evidence for this event case.
Intel's IPMI specification defines sensor events, event data and a standard SEL Full indication, but no standard `InfoErr` category or project-specific RealErr distinction.
The approved rules prohibit guessed RAS/event injection and require SEL evidence preservation before deletion/fill operations; no repository package provides the necessary generator, map or recovery.

test_case.test_name: SEL_InfoErr_Full — platform-defined informational event and separate SEL-capacity checkpoint
test_case.purpose: After BMC RD defines the contract, first prove one named informational sensor event has the approved SDR identity, threshold behavior and assert/deassert SEL encoding distinct from RealErr; then, only if confirmed in scope, separately prove the platform's documented SEL-full/overflow retention policy without losing baseline evidence.
required_package: BMC RD event taxonomy defining InfoErr and its exact distinction from RealErr
Target sensor/generator, SDR record/type/units, event/reading code, severity, data bytes and assertion/deassertion mapping
Vendor-approved physical simulator or injection tool, isolation, limits, aborts and recovery
SEL capacity/overflow/overwrite specification, non-production generation method, baseline export/hash and cleanup/retention plan
Validated private script revision and exact applicability if it will be used
test_case.test_command: NOT STARTED — do not heat/cool hardware, alter thresholds, inject events, fill/clear SEL, or run the private script until BMC RD supplies the event and capacity contracts. Read-only `ipmitool sdr elist`, `sensor list`, `sel info` and `sel elist` are evidence helpers only and cannot produce PASS.
test_case.expected_result: Unavailable as a single authorized oracle. The InfoErr checkpoint must produce exactly the approved informational-class assert/deassert entries for the named target, with bounded telemetry and no RealErr/critical event. The independent capacity checkpoint must reach the documented boundary, emit the expected SEL-full/overflow state, preserve records according to policy, and recover without erasing required evidence.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is authorized until the owner publishes both the event-class oracle and whether the SEL-capacity checkpoint is mandatory. PASS for one checkpoint cannot satisfy the other. Any wrong class/severity/data, uncontrolled thermal response, evidence overwrite, undocumented wrap behavior or failed recovery is FAIL/stop under the approved plan; until the plan exists this case remains BLOCKED.
safety_gate: No guessed sensor stimulus, threshold write, environmental change or RAS injection
Export and hash the complete pre-test SEL and collect capacity state before any approved generation
Never clear SEL merely to prepare or clean up; deletion/clear requires separate approval and preserved evidence
Use independent thermal/fan/power/BMC monitoring and stop on real fault, critical event, telemetry loss or BMC instability
Do not automatically retry the first unexpected event or overflow behavior
expected_evidence: Owner-approved InfoErr/RealErr comparison and row/variant identity
Target SDR/event specification plus generator/tool/fixture versions and authorization
Hashed baseline SEL and exact capacity/retention configuration
Timestamped stimulus, independent health telemetry and raw/decoded assert/deassert records
If capacity is required: per-step entry accounting, full/overflow flag, oldest/newest retention and cleanup/recovery
Restored sensor/BMC/SEL state and coverage statement
test_case.recovery: No recovery sequence is safe to invent. The approved package must state how to stop the simulator/injector, return the sensor to normal, deassert the event, preserve rather than clear SEL evidence, and recover BMC access/capacity. Stop and escalate on the first wrong class, thermal excursion, overwrite or instability.

source_conflict.reason: InfoErr and RealErr have indistinguishable source behavior, while sensor assertion and SEL-capacity semantics are conflated and no controlling platform specification resolves them.

blocked.reason: Core OEM event semantics, safe stimulus, authoritative Expected Result and evidence-preserving capacity recovery are absent.

pending.release_condition: Publish the approved event and capacity contracts, then re-review this exact Source Key and variant without modifying the protected Master.

external_authorities.title: Intel IPMI v2.0 Specification update
